REASONS_LABEL: Why do you want to report this player?
REASON_OFFENSIVE_LANGUAGE_TIP: Including, but not limited to language that is vulgar, obscene, sexually explicit, or racially, ethnically, or otherwise objectionable.
REASON_VERBAL_ABUSE_TIP: Including, but not limited to language that is unlawful, harmful, threatening, abusive, harassing, defamatory, or otherwise objectionable.
REASON_GRIEFING_TIP: Commander recycling structures mid game, players blocking entry to the Command Chair etc.
REASON_SPAMMING_TIP: Disrupting the flow of conversation with repeated posts of a similar nature, whether for personal or commercial purposes.
REASON_ADVERTISING_TIP: Promoting other servers, communities or websites, e.g. asking players to join another server.
REASON_NEGATIVE_ATTITUDE_TIP: Constantly putting other players down or being generally negative about the game.
REASON_INAPPROPRIATE_NAME_TIP: The player's name contains personally identifying information, infringes on the proprietary rights of a third party, or is offensive, defamatory, vulgar, obscene, sexually explicit, racially, ethnically, or otherwise objectionable.
REASON_UNSKILLED_TIP: The player lacks the skill to play on this server.
REASON_STACKING_TIP: The player constantly switches teams to unbalance them.
REASON_SMURFING_TIP: The player is suspected to use an alternative account.
REASON_CHEATING_TIP: The player is suspected to cheat or to use in-game exploits.
REPORT_SENT: Thank you! Your report has been sent to the server operators.
ERROR_INVALID_TARGET: This player can not be reported.
ERROR_ALREADY_REPORTED: You have already reported this player.
ERROR_REPORT_COOLDOWN: Please wait a moment before sending another report.
NEW_REPORT: {ReporterName} reported {TargetName}. Check the Reports tab of the admin menu for details.
